findings.title: Unusual behaviour in nng_repro[1]
findings.summary: nng_repro[1] (prio 10) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 250 of its 250 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 5000 ms. It stands out in: time waiting on a condition variable (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), time asleep (lower than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is priority inversion while waiting on a condition variable, but only loosely (distance 9.83 against 0.847 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
